docs#AddMonoidHom.addSubmonoidMap_apply_coe and docs#LinearMap.submoduleMap_coe_apply seem to do the same computation in two close frameworks.
Shouldn't their names be aligned, either to apply_coe or coe_apply?
(But I can't decide which.)
coe_submoduleMap_apply looks like the right name to me
Usually you're a sure colleague in these matters; if anybody else confirms that it is appropriate, I'll find the time to PR a change.

I guess I should be clear that I mean "this looks like what the naming convention would suggest", but what I didn't say is "we almost universally do something else", which is usually "whatever @[simps] does when we're not looking"
